title: Linked-worktree provider association: accept a Windows case-only spelling difference of the same directory instead of refusing
outcome: Raised as a Medium by the R3 review of w-5c8b45a10439 (candidate f19fa528) and downgraded to Low by the coordinator. In src/delegation_git_boundary.rs:416-422, the checked handles can refer to the same case-insensitive Windows directory, yet raw path equality refuses the Git backlink and common pointer when the provider spells the casing differently. The result is a fail-closed explicit refusal of association, which w-5c8b45a10439's outcome ('preserve OR explicitly refuse') allows; it is not a wrong association. Improvement: compare verified native identities of the exact backlink marker and common directory through the existing no-follow path walk, keep real distinct entries on case-sensitive directories, and add a Windows same-object association test with a Windows run.
acceptance: Linked-worktree provider association: accept a Windows case-only spelling difference of the same directory instead of refusing is done
